licenseFinding: The pinned CE License.txt says image, music and sound creators retain full rights and permits those assets to be copied only to run NeoLemmix. The licence lists owners for some styles, but it does not list 18 of the 44 referenced style identifiers. No redistribution permission is recorded here. This inventory is a rights follow-up list, not a legal interpretation.
